title: Haptic Glove
summary: Wearable finger tracking and force feedback for tactile VR interaction.
description: A wearable glove designed to track each finger's pose with Hall-effect sensors and provide force feedback through low-power servos. The design connects a microcontroller to a PC driver, with the goal of letting users feel an object's firmness as they pick it up in VR.

title: Persistent-Memory Glasses
summary: Camera and display-enabled smart glasses that help you remember your conversations.
description: Ever wish you had a HUD for your conversations? We are creating a persistent-memory framework with the RayNeo X3 Pros (camera + displays) to record, diarize, and store previous facts and conversations. The system will intelligently remember relevant context to the user and alert via the glasses' on-screen displays.

title: Awake
summary: An experimental Unity stealth-horror VR game exploring novel VR mechanics.
description: An experimental stealth-horror game made in Unity that tests different novel mechanics.

title: Omnidirectional Treadmill
summary: Run a mile in VR, in any direction, without leaving the room.
description: An all-in-one device responsible for mimicking natural movements while keeping its user in place.

title: BCI Controller
summary: An exploration of brain-computer input as an alternative controller for VR.
description: This project explores alternative VR input methods while developing a more generalizable BCI controller for VR applications. We take raw brainwaves and pass it through our machine learning models, resulting in input for movement, actions, and even communication via keyboard.

title: Force-Feedback Arm
summary: A force-feedback arm that restricts movement when virtual environments are touched.
description: An arm designed to restrict movement in certain VR scenarios. When a user touches a virtual wall, for example, the arm reacts to the environment and can restrict the user's arm to provide realistic feedback.

title: Olfactory Display
summary: A wearable display that synchronizes scents with virtual reality environments.
description: A wearable device mounted beneath a VR headset that delivers scents directly to the user's nose. Electronically controlled fans and atomizers convert liquid into vapor and synchronize smelling with the virtual reality environment in real time.
